run_main: run the pre-trained PPO agent on the minitaur trotting environment and log total reward
run_load_config: load the PPO policy configuration from the minitaur trotting environment log directory
run_simple_ppo_policy: create a SimplePPOPolicy agent with a TensorFlow session, environment, network, and checkpoint path
run_get_action: get the next action from the PPO agent given an environment observation
run_env_step: step the minitaur trotting environment with an action and return observation, reward, and done flag
